summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Medical Devices textbook app. All 17 pytest backend tests passed (meta, TOC structure, 11 preview sections + 404, PDF status, PDF download w/ headers). Frontend dashboard renders correctly: sidebar with 6 phases, all 4 KPIs (93/2-of-14/8/9), TOC panel, chapter status badges, cover card, phase tracker, PDF download triggers valid application/pdf 200 response. Preview iframe successfully switches src on TOC row click and cover-thumb click, and iframe body content is served (ch01 preview loads full typeset HTML).

minor.issue: Returned HTML references fonts via relative path (e.g. 'fonts/Manrope-SemiBold.ttf'). When rendered inside the dashboard preview iframe, the browser resolves them to /api/book/preview/fonts/*.ttf which return 404 (7 font files x each section). PDF generation via WeasyPrint is unaffected (reads from filesystem). Recommend serving /api/book/preview/fonts/* as static or using absolute URLs / embedding as base64 for the browser preview.

issues: Badge text is rendered uppercase via CSS (COMPLETE / IN DEV) though spec examples used title-case ('Complete', 'In Dev'). Cosmetic only; underlying values from API are correct.

action_items: Serve /api/book/preview/fonts/* (mount StaticFiles pointing to backend/book/fonts) so the browser preview iframe can load the custom fonts and match the printed PDF typography.
(Optional cosmetic) Decide if badge label should render 'Complete'/'In Dev' rather than uppercase CSS transform.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview HTML uses relative font paths without a corresponding static route — leads to 6-7 404s per preview load in the browser (only affects on-screen preview, not PDF).
PDF pre-warm at startup works well (status=ready with pages=93 on first hit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_book_api.py (17 tests, all pass). Preview iframe font 404s are the only outstanding issue; fix is to mount StaticFiles for /api/book/preview/fonts pointing at /app/backend/book/fonts.
rca of the issue: Assembler embeds @font-face src: url('fonts/Xxx.ttf'). In the FastAPI preview response the base URL is /api/book/preview/{sid}, so relative 'fonts/…' resolves to /api/book/preview/fonts/… which has no route — 404. WeasyPrint resolves the same URL through its own base-url/file loader and finds the .ttf on disk, so the generated PDF is correct.
